assertionResults.reason: The browser handoff landed on https://hack-cli.hack/account and rendered the signed-in account shell for UT Admin Shell. Broker /v1/auth/me returned the same userId/email/name for both the browser session cookie and the claimed management token, and isolated CLI auth status/whoami JSON matched the same identity with no active org or team. After clearing cookies, /account failed closed to a shell with only a Continue to sign in action instead of stale identity data.

The broker session-start flow issued a browser-owned authorizeUrl on https://hack-cli.hack/auth with a trusted redirect to https://hack-cli.hack/account. In the browser session, /auth?redirect=%2Faccount rendered the sign-in surface; after establishing the same authenticated identity through the claimed broker management token and following View browser handoff status, the browser landed on /account. Broker current-user and protected invitations routes both returned authenticated continuity for the same identity.

frictions.description: agent-browser did not capture request entries for this local redirect flow after the handoff, even though the browser transition succeeded.
frictions.resolution: Used direct HTTP response evidence from session-start, flow-claim, /v1/auth/me, and /v1/auth/invitations instead of relying on the empty browser-network-requests log.

commands.command: curl -ksS -c <tmp>/better-auth.cookies.txt -b <tmp>/better-auth.cookies.txt -H 'origin: https://auth.hack-cli.hack' -H 'referer: https://auth.hack-cli.hack/' -H 'content-type: application/json' -X POST https://auth.hack-cli.hack/api/auth/sign-up/email ... || curl -ksS ... /api/auth/sign-in/email ...
commands.observation: Reused the isolated disposable account ut-admin-shell-43ecf94098e7.owner@example.com through the real Better Auth email/password API and stored the authenticated browser cookie jar.
Started a trusted /account browser handoff, completed the broker bridge for the same signed-in user, and claimed a management token for CLI parity checks.
Captured the browser-owned auth entrypoint showing Continue with GitHub plus the View browser handoff status link for the requested /account redirect.

commands.command: agent-browser --session 43ecf94098e7__u1 cookies set hack_web_broker_session <redacted> && click @e2 && wait --url **/account && screenshot --annotate .../VAL-ADMIN-001-account-shell.annotated.png
commands.observation: Following the browser handoff status link with the claimed management-token cookie landed the same browser session on https://hack-cli.hack/account and rendered the signed-in account shell.

commands.command: HOME=<tmp>/home HACK_GLOBAL_CONFIG_PATH=<tmp>/global-config.json HACK_SECRETS_FILE_KEY=<redacted> HACK_AUTH_BROKER_URL=https://auth.hack-cli.hack /Users/hack/dev/hack-dance/hack/dist/hack auth status --json && ... auth whoami --json && ... auth invites --json
commands.observation: The isolated CLI session resolved the same authenticated user and empty invitations state as the broker responses.

commands.command: agent-browser --session 43ecf94098e7__u1 cookies clear && open https://hack-cli.hack/account && snapshot -i
commands.observation: With cookies cleared, /account failed closed and exposed only a Continue to sign in action instead of stale identity context.

summary: Passed 2/2 assertions. The browser-owned auth route for /account, broker current-user/protected-route responses, and isolated CLI auth status all agreed on the same UT Admin Shell identity and no active org/team context.
